notes.title: Announcing the EreaDrone Challengers League
notes.content: [p]We are happy to announce the EreaDrone Challengers League! A series of Drone Racing and Challenge events, which are open to absolutely everybody, especially beginner and intermediate pilots. And we are holding the very first event [i]this week[/i]![/p][p][/p][h3]📅Bi-Weekly Events📅[/h3][p]The events will happen almost every two weeks on Saturdays, on the EU/America timeslot: 15:00 UTC, [u]or[/u] on the Asia timeslot: 7:00 UTC. The events will be quicker than our current FAI eDRWC events, taking 1h30 including all the phases. On weeks where we are running an FAI e-Drone Racing World Cup event, there will be no Challengers events.[/p][p][/p][h3]📐Format📐[/h3][p]Depending on turnout, there will be 32 or 64 participating pilots. All races will have 8 pilots at the same time. There will be a live-stream to follow the races. During the season, there will be rewards that you can earn for participating and winning.[/p][p]The rules are also more flexible in Challengers events, so expect some changes! We will give you more freedom to choose how you want to fly.[/p][p][/p][h3]📏4 types of events📏[/h3][p]There are 4 types of Challengers events:[/p][p]- 🥇[b]Race[/b], a standard race with multiple laps[/p][p]- 🏎️[b]Sprint[/b], an A-to-B race, racing to the finish line[/p][p]- 🤏[b]Tiny[/b], races and challenges with a tiny drone[/p][p]- 🏆[b]Trial[/b], where everyone competes separately for the best time or score[/p][p][/p][h3]🌬️2025 Challengers Event #1: Zephyrus Race🌬️[/h3][p]We are holding the very first Challengers event this week! [/p][p]The [b][i]Challengers Event 1: Zephyrus Race[/i][/b] is now open for registration, and you can already fly your qualification laps as well. The event will be held on this Saturday 13th, at 15:00 UTC.[/p][p]The [b]Zephyrus Race[/b] takes place on a community track designed by [i][u]SKAN AIR[/u][/i], that was slightly modified to fit the event.[/p][p]For this event, we allow you to use any drone model you want with its default settings.[/p][p][url="https://ereadrone.com/tournament/19"]Sign up here for the 2025 Challengers Event 1: Zephyrus Race![/url][/p][p][/p][p]We will share a full calendar soon, stay tuned.[/p][p][/p][p]Hope to see you there![/p][p][/p][p]- The EreaDrone Team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Optimization Update (and annoucing the Physics Update)
notes.content: [p][b]Hi Pilots![/b][/p][p align="justify"]Here’s a small update, mostly centred on [b]performance optimization[/b]. We hope you like it, and it should fix some problems if you have any. We would like to remind you that the [url="https://ereadrone.com/tournament/18"]registrations are still open to the second event of the 2025 FAI eDRWC[/url], so sign up now if you haven’t already! Also…[/p][p][/p][h3]⏰[b]ANNOUNCING THE CHALLENGERS LEAGUE[/b]⏰[/h3][p]We are now running a new series of competitive events: the EreaDrone Challengers League. Read more about it, and [url="https://ereadrone.com/challengers"]sign up here[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔜COMING SOON : ⚖️[i]PHYSICS UPDATE✨[/i][/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Releasing soon, we are announcing the often-requested [b][i]Physics Update[/i][/b]! It will [b]overhaul physics[/b], give you more options to tweak them, including a [b]gravity slider[/b], and will include an [b]in-game guide[/b] to explain what all those confusing sliders mean to help you get the physics that suit you best. Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]But before that, here’s the changelog for the current update:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🆕 NEW FEATURES 🆕[/b] [/h2][p][/p][h3]🌄DLSS 3.7, FSR 3.1, and XeSS 2.1 Support:[/h3][p]You can now turn on your AI upscaler of choice, which lets you enjoy higher frame-rates and better visuals. They are available to choose from in the Anti-aliasing option.[/p][p][/p][h3]🖼️Import an image in the Track Editor:[/h3][p align="justify"]You can now import [i]any image[/i] into the track editor and move it around/scale it as you want. This can be helpful to reproduce any real track layout, if you have a picture of it. This is only to help you build a track, and it will not show up once you decide to publish the track.[/p][p][/p][h3]📊Improved Drone Interpolation:[/h3][p align="justify"]In Multiplayer, drones of other players were often stuttery and distracting. With this new system, they should now fly smoothly and be accurate to how other players fly them at all times.[/p][p][/p][h3]🌬️Ground Hovering FX:[/h3][p align="justify"]In Multiplayer, you can now see some visual effects of the drones hovering over the ground. This is tied to the [i]Volumetric Clouds[/i] setting, so you can turn it on/off that way.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h2][b]👀AVAILABLE FEATURES 🔦[/b][/h2][p align="justify"][i]Over various recent patches, we discreetly added a few features, but we never told you about them… So here’s a small list of what’s new since the Rework Update:[/i][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]🎛️[b]High Quality Collision[/b] option. Turning this on will simulate drone collisions with the ground and obstacles more accurately. Please note that this will use more system resources.[/p][p align="justify"]🔭You can now use Ctrl + scroll to [b]change your FOV in Map View Mode[/b][/p][p align="justify"]🏷️You can [b]hide other players’ names in Multiplayer[/b] (Options -> Display others’ names). We know this is often requested, and it's already in the game![/p][p]  [/p][p][/p][h2][b]📊PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS ⚙️[/b][/h2][p align="justify"][i]Here are the major changes in this update! We have major CPU and memory optimizations, and especially reduced memory allocation. This should help your game run smoother and minimize some of the issues with stutters and weird frame pacing.[/i][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]- Better support for VRR and Low Framerate Compensation on compatible monitors[/p][p align="justify"]- Controller polling should now be more efficient[/p][p align="justify"]- Minor optimization in the Stadium environment[/p][p align="justify"]- Various bug fixes related to performance[/p][p align="justify"]- VSync and Target FPS are now independent of the quality presets[/p][p align="justify"]- Removed “Unlimited” Target Framerate option[/p][p align="justify"][i]We removed the Unlimited option because it caused lag spikes and uneven frame pacing, which do not occur when the framerate is capped. Instead, you will still have the option to choose a max framerate up to what your monitor can support, so your input latency will not be affected.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️BUG FIXES 🔧[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]⚠️Major : [/h3][p align="justify"]- Fixed missing Game Ending sequence and Spawn Selection screen in certain scenarios[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed occasional fatal game crash related to the initialisation of drone physics[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed Local Server crashing because the ports were not available[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed Tutorial mode not starting, causing the player to be stuck in the lobby settings without the start button[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed alternative fonts not working, making some non-Latin (especially Chinese, Korean, and Japanese) characters into squares[/p][p align="justify"]- Removed a 3rd Party tool that was sometimes wrongly detected as malware by some antivirus software[/p][p][/p][h3]🔎Minor:[/h3][p align="justify"]- Various security and networking fixes[/p][p align="justify"]- Various visual fixes[/p][p align="justify"]- Various fixes related to controllers and input[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed the mouse cursor never becoming invisible in certain cases[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed drones stuttering in spectator mode[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed issue where drones were locked when joining a lobby after the lobby already started[/p][p align="justify"]- Various bug fixes related to events[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed Drone Collision detection for High-Quality Collision setting, sometimes not giving back adequate control[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed a bug where localized text inside buttons was not updating when changing locale/language[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed game blocking exception when the droneprofile.ed file is corrupted[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed the Replay reader playing too quickly[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed the wrong font in the Game Mode Selection screen[/p][p align="justify"]- Fixed bloom settings not being applied everywhere, and made bloom stronger[/p][p align="justify"]- General updates to packages and game components[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]And that’s it![/p][p][/p][p align="right"]- The EreaDrone Team[/p]

notes.title: Fly to win in the FAI Italy e-Drone Racing World Cup
notes.content: [p][b]EreaDrone[/b] is once again hosting the official [b][i]FAI e-Drone Racing World Cup[/i][/b], this time in Italy… [i]virtualy[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Race with the best on the track of the [i]2025 FAI Italy Drone Racing World Cup[/i], and compete for the podium all season long! If you want to train or just fly along, the map is also available in the [b]Map Browser[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Qualify and compete from your own computer: this is a [i]completly remote event[/i]. You have until [u]September 18th, 23:59 UTC[/u] to submit your times.[/p][p]The event will be livestreamed when it starts on [u]Saturday 20th September, at 1PM UTC[/u]![/p][p][/p][p][b][u]To watch it:[/u][/b][/p][p]The event will be streamed on the [url="https://www.youtube.com/@airsports_fai"]official FAI Youtube Channel[/url] when it starts.[/p][p][/p][p]This event is open for everyone to register, even without an FAI Sporting License. Some restrictions apply.[/p][p]To participate, you will need to join the EreaDrone Discord server: [url="https://discord.gg/mBEd7Abskw"]https://discord.gg/mBEd7Abskw[/url][/p]

notes.title: The Rework Update is finally live
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear EreaDrone Community,[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been away since the end of last year’s e-Drone season, but don’t worry, we’ve been cooking! We’re finally back and have been hard at work behind the scenes to make EreaDrone bigger and better. The changes we have made are mostly technical, but we have a few cool new features to showcase as well.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]A Big, Technical Update[/h3][p]This update is quite big, but we can assure you it’s worth it. We have done a LOT of changes in the background of the game, to make it run better and allow us to do more in the future. There's a lot to download, but don’t worry: the game will now take LESS space on your drive than before, about 7 GB less in fact. The game should also run better in general and use fewer system resources. We have also added a few Quality-of-Life features in the UI. Although it's not very flashy, you can now enjoy a better drone-flying experience! [/p][p][/p][p]All those big changes are mostly in the background, but here’s some more foreground stuff.[/p][p][/p][h3]2025 World Games Official Track[/h3][p]For all those participating in the 2025 World Games in Chengdu this year, we are excited to host the official simulator track, available with this update. Fly and train on the official peculiarly-shaped track, and race your way to victory![/p][p]The track unlocks on June 27th at 14:00 CET (20:00 CST, 8 AM EDT, 15:00 AST, 21:00 JST)[/p][p]To access it in-game, search for “[i]The World Games 2025[/i]” in the track selection once it unlocks.[/p][p][/p][h3]VR Mode \[Beta][/h3][p]We have now added VR support to the Track Editor and select Environments, currently in Beta. In this mode, you can fly your drone as if you were right there on the track, and use it while building your track to get a real sense of scale and how the track feels. Feel free to try it out with your VR headset![/p][p]Please note this feature is still in Beta, so don’t hesitate to report any issues you have with it.[/p][p][/p][h3]Steam Summer Sale[/h3][p]To celebrate this new update, the upcoming competitive season, and the Steam Summer Sale, we’re happy to announce that EreaDrone is running a -40% sale. Get it while you can![/p][p][/p][h3]2025 FAI e-Drone World Cup, soon?[/h3][p]We are hard at work to prepare this year’s competitive e-Drone season, including some simulator optimizations. You will hear from us very soon regarding the 2025 FAI e-Drone Racing World Cup, so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]Warm regards,[/p][p]The EreaDrone Team[/p][p][/p][p]---[/p][p][/p][h2]Detailed Changelog:[/h2][p][/p][h3]🆕 New Features & Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p][b]The World Games[/b]: The official drone racing track of the 2025 World Games in Chengdu will be availalbe on June 27th at 14:00 CET (20:00 CST, 8 AM EDT, 15:00 AST, 21:00 JST)[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[BETA] VR mode[/b]: See the world in VR while in the Track Editor, or in game in a few select Environments [/p][/*][*][p][b]Text Chat[/b]: The Text chat is now available during the entire lobby's life, and can be seen directly in the lobby even when the game hasn't started yet[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leaderboards[/b]: Leaderboard are now available from lobbies, session settings, and escape menu directly[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Loadings[/b]: Loading screens now displays progress instead of freezing the game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🚀 Optimisations & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Files restructuration[/b]: Game files and systems have been completely restructured, making the game take less space on the disk (40.4Go -> 33.2Go)[/p][/*][*][p][b]RAM optimisation[/b]: RAM usage has been optimised, resulting in less memory use in most situations[/p][/*][*][p][b]Engine[/b]: Upgraded Unity Engine to version 6.1[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI stability[/b]: The UI has been completely reworked behind the scenes, making it more stable and flexible[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved multiplayer[/b]: Better performance and stability for multiplayer, game server upgraded to a new version[/p][/*][*][p][b]Depth of field[/b]: Depth of field graphical option is now disabled by default in all quality presets[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better spectator mode[/b]: Spectator camera system has been improved for a better drone tracking and camera selection[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved drone collision[/b]: Drone collission behaviour has been improved in direct mode, making it more physically accurate[/p][/*][*][p][b]Environment lighting[/b]: Improved and optimised environment lighting[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localisation[/b]: Updated some localisation text[/p][/*][*][p]Many other minor optimisations and improvements [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🧹 Bug fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bugs notes.title: Exciting updates and features!
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear EreaDrone Community,[/b]

Following up from our last post, [url="/post/more-languages-better-multiplayer"][u]More Languages, Better Multiplayer[/u][/url], EreaDrone has continued to evolve with a series of exciting updates and improvements. The team has been hard at work enhancing both gameplay and the overall user experience. Below, we highlight some of the key changes and optimizations that have been rolled out over the past few months.


[/p][h3]Network and Performance Optimizations[/h3][p]One of the key focus areas has been [b]improving the game's network infrastructure and optimizing the netcode[/b]. Significant upgrades have been made, resulting in stabilized tick rates, better multiplayer experiences, and enhanced UDP connection reliability. Alongside these improvements, the overall graphics and UI performance have seen various tweaks to ensure smoother gameplay.
[/p][h3]Improved Multiplayer Experience[/h3][p]EreaDrone’s multiplayer functionality has taken a big step forward. [b]The number of spectator slots has increased from 4 to 12[/b], allowing for more engagement in races. Additionally, drone sound realism has been enhanced, so you can now [b]hear all the drones spatially around you in multiplayer[/b], adding an extra layer of immersion as you can pinpoint their locations by sound alone during intense races.
[/p][h3]Bug Fixes and General Stability[/h3][p]We've squashed a number of bugs that were affecting the gameplay experience. Notable fixes include resolving issues with the "Apply" button in the options screen, lighting initialization times in maps, and FPS target saving problems. [b]Stability has also been enhanced across the game[/b], including addressing crashes related to game-ending animations and water penalties being improperly triggered for all players at once.
[/p][h3]Enhanced Map Editor[/h3][p]The Map Editor has undergone significant improvements, adding [b]new track elements[/b], [b]procedural square and circle elements, and an innovative "A to B" mode[/b] for track creation, offering more flexibility to players. These updates allow you to design tracks that are not just loops, but also linear point-to-point races. Additional fixes in the editor include gizmos showing correctly and path visibility being adjustable in the Options Panel.
[/p][h3]Tournament Mode and UI Upgrades[/h3][p]The Tournament UI has been refined to be more intuitive, ensuring that all interactions are smoother. Confirmation popups have been added to qualification mode to reduce the likelihood of accidental qualification attempts usage. There's also a countdown feature in qualification mode that now gives players more control over when they’re ready to start. The overall user interface has received multiple optimizations to enhance fluidity and responsiveness.
[/p][h3]Drone Showroom Overhaul[/h3][p]For drone enthusiasts, the Drone Showroom has been visually enhanced to provide a [b]clearer and more striking display of each drone[/b]. The environment surrounding the drone has been minimized, spotlighting the drone in a "photobooth" style, making every detail stand out.
[/p][h3]New Features for Pilots[/h3][p]Drone control has been refined with the [b]addition of Actual Rates in the Rate Settings[/b], giving pilots more detailed control over their drone's behavior. A new "Finish" button after races has been added to streamline race conclusions, allowing you to proceed seamlessly between races.
[/p][h3]New Skins and Customization[/h3][p]EreaDrone has introduced two stunning new skins for the Standard drone model: the [u]Inaugural e-Drone[/u] and [u]Alpine e-Drone[/u]. These designs offer fresh ways to stand out on the track.
[/p][h3]FAI World Drone Racing Championship Track[/h3][p]In celebration of the [b]FAI World Drone Racing Championship 2024[/b], we've added the official track for players to experience the thrill of competing on a world-class course. This track was [b]developed in close collaboration with the FAI[/b], continuing our partnership that began in 2018 with the first World Drone Racing Championship (WDRC). Furthermore, this same track will be used for the 2024 FAI WDRC e-Drone Racing World Cup, for which registration opens on Saturday, September 28th. Get ready to join the competition and race like a pro!
[/p][h3]Miscellaneous Tweaks and Features[/h3][p]Other smaller, yet impactful, updates include [b]better drone collision detection [/b]for trusses in the Map Editor, [b]improved camera switching for spectators[/b], and [b]longer drone trails in spectator mode[/b]. We've also included a [b]Screen Settings Resetter (Ctrl + Alt + Shift + F11) [/b]to easily revert to default display settings, ensuring that your preferences are always recoverable.



We are deeply grateful for your continued support, feedback, and passion. Thanks to you, EreaDrone is evolving into much more than a drone simulator—it's becoming a vibrant, dynamic community of racers, creators, and enthusiasts. Your ideas and suggestions have helped shape many of the updates you see today, and we invite you to dive into the detailed changelog below to discover how your input has made a difference.

Your voice matters to us, and we’d love to hear more! Consider leaving a review on Steam to share your thoughts—it truly helps us keep growing and improving.

Here’s to pushing boundaries, soaring higher, and racing faster—together!

Warm regards,
The EreaDrone Team

---


[/p][h2][b]Detailed changelog[/b][/h2][p]
[/p][h3]🆕 New Features & Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Actual Rates in Rate Settings:[/b] Pilots can now fine-tune their drone control experience with the introduction of Actual Rates in the Rate Settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A to B Mode in Map Editor:[/b] Create even more dynamic tracks by choosing between loop or A to B mode when designing your courses.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded Spectator Slots:[/b] Multiplayer races are now more exciting, with spectator capacity increasing from 4 to 12.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Procedural Gates in Map Editor:[/b] Design the ultimate track with two new procedural gate elements, Square and Circle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Track Elements in Map Editor:[/b] A wider array of track elements has been added to inspire your creativity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Screen Settings Resetter:[/b] Quickly reset your display settings (Ctrl + Alt + Shift + F11) to default for DisplayMode, Monitor, Resolution, VSync, and AspectRatio.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Drone Skins:[/b] Customize your drones with two new skins for the Standard model: the [u]Inaugural e-Drone[/u] and [u]Alpine e-Drone[/u].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Finish Button:[/b] End races seamlessly with a newly added “Finish” button that appears after crossing the finish line.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Qualification Mode Countdown:[/b] Now you’re in control! The qualification countdown only starts when you're ready to race.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Confirmation Popups in Qualification Mode:[/b] Avoid accidental actions with added confirmation popups in qualification mode.[/p][/*][*][p][b]FAI World Drone Racing Championship 2024 Track:[/b] Race on the official FAI World Drone Racing Championship 2024 track, developed in partnership with the FAI.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drone Sounds in Multiplayer:[/b] Experience spatial audio in multiplayer—hear every drone around you for heightened immersion.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🚀 Optimizations and improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Direct Rotation Mode Optimizations:[/b] Major improvements have been made for those using Direct Rotation Mode, delivering quicker, more efficient drone responses.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tournament UI Enhancements:[/b] The Tournament UI has been revamped for a more streamlined and user-friendly experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Netcode and Network Optimization:[/b] Expect smoother races with major netcode updates and stabilization of the tick rate.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spectator Mode Enhancements:[/b] Better camera switching and longer drone trails in Spectator Mode improve the viewer experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map Editor Improvements:[/b] Triggers in the Map Editor no longer block the selection of other objects, and drone collision detection has been improved for Truss elements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drone Showroom Overhaul:[/b] The Drone Showroom now offers a cleaner, more focused view of your drone by removing the surrounding environment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Harbour Environment Optimization:[/b] The Harbour environment has been optimized for better performance and smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]General Graphics and UI Improvements:[/b] Numerous small enhancements have been made to the game's overall graphics and user interface for a smoother, more polished experience.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔧 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Map Editor Gizmos Fix:[/b] Gizmos are now correctly displayed in the Map Editor.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Target FPS Saving:[/b] Resolved an issue where target FPS wasn’t being saved in the Options Panel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]School Map Lighting:[/b] Fixed lighting issues that were occurring on the School map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Target FPS Bug:[/b] Addressed a rare bug that set the target FPS between 0 and 6 FPS.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Options Panel Apply Button:[/b] Fixed the Apply button in the Options Panel that wasn’t working properly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lighting Initialization:[/b] Lighting now initializes faster, fixing long load times in certain maps.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cursor Visibility Fix:[/b] Resolved the issue of the cursor remaining hidden when popups were active.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drone Arming with Popup:[/b] Fixed a bug that allowed the drone to arm even when a popup was displayed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UDP Connection Issues:[/b] Fixed several cases where UDP connections weren’t working as expected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Propeller Animation Bug:[/b] Other players’ drone propellers now spin correctly during multiplayer sessions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Progress Bar Stability:[/b] The Progress Bar is now stable, eliminating vibration issues.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Track Path Visibility:[/b] The track path in the Map Editor is now correctly hidden or shown based on the Options Panel settings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multiplayer Game-End Crashes:[/b] Fixed crashes that occurred when a pilot disconnected during the game-ending animation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Water Caustic notes.title: More Languages, Better Multiplayer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41843755/8a2e88134fc3b320f8cda6c27d0b362182d5f314.png[/img]

[b]Dear EreaDrone Community,[/b]

Exciting news for our community: [b]"EreaDrone 2023" has officially been renamed to "EreaDrone"[/b] to better reflect our ongoing commitment to continuous improvement and updates throughout the year and beyond.

We're thrilled to share our latest update, designed to enhance your flight experience with new features, improvements, and fixes.

[b]What's New:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Revamped Multiplayer System:[/b] Behind the scenes, we've entirely redeveloped the multiplayer infrastructure to ensure [b]smoother, more reliable connections[/b]—improvements you'll feel even if you don't see them.
[*][b]New Languages:[/b] Enjoy the simulator in additional languages, including [b]Spanish, German, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Ukrainian, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, and Polish[/b].
[*][b]HUD Enhancements:[/b] Easily toggle your flight HUD with 'H'. Plus, a new HUD crosshair improves targeting and flying precision.
[*][b]Elo Ratings Enhance Multiplayer:[/b] Elevate your competition with Elo ratings, now tracked in multiplayer sessions. This update brings a dynamic way to measure and display your flying prowess, adding depth to every match.
[*][b]Optimizations for Smoother Play:[/b] Experience less stutter during key moments like joining games or finishing laps.
[*][b]'Void' Environment:[/b] 'Void' is like the 'Flat' environment but has no ground. It's perfect for map creators who want to build anything they can think of, with total freedom.
[*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] We've eliminated invisible collision issues with trees, among other minor improvements such as the issue where rate profile selections weren't saved, requiring reselection at each game launch..
[*][b]Improved Race Experience:[/b] The live race ranking system has been enhanced for a more competitive environment.
[*][b]Leaderboard Insights:[/b] View used drone profiles on the website's leaderboard for better competition analysis.
[*][b]Server Region Expansion (In Progress):[/b] We're working on introducing server regions, beginning with Europe, with the potential for Asia and America in the future.
[/list]

This update also includes various other optimizations and minor fixes aimed at refining your experience with EreaDrone.

[b]Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm![/b]

Warm regards,

The EreaDrone 2023 Team

notes.title: EreaDrone 2023: 5 months of continuous updates since its release
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41843755/d27a18b4c60740c545adb30d11297daef263b9d6.png[/img]

[b]Dear EreaDrone Community,[/b]

Five months ago, we embarked on an ambitious journey with the [b]release of EreaDrone 2023[/b]. We were met with enthusiasm and passion from the drone racing community. However, we also faced challenges, as reflected in the feedback and reviews from our initial release. Your honest opinions have been invaluable, and we've taken every word to heart.

We understand that the journey of [b]EreaDrone 2023 didn't start as smoothly as we all hoped[/b]. The issues you faced – from performance glitches to physics refinement needs – were not in line with the high standards we set for ourselves. But every challenge is an opportunity for growth, and we've been dedicated to turning your feedback into actionable improvements.

Over the past five months, [b]we have worked tirelessly to not just address these issues, but to also enhance and expand the EreaDrone experience[/b]. We've listened, learned, and evolved. Today, we are proud to present significant updates that we believe will [b]redefine your EreaDrone 2023 experience[/b].

Here's a snapshot of what we've achieved together:
[list]
[*] [b]Major Performance Upgrades[/b]: We've tackled the stuttering and FPS issues head-on, ensuring a smoother and more responsive simulation experience.
[*] [b]Enhanced Physics and Realism[/b]: Your feedback drove significant improvements in drone physics, making every flight more thrilling and true-to-life.
[*] [b]User Interface and Quality of Life Improvements[/b]: From leaderboard integrations to customizable settings, every aspect has been refined for a more intuitive and engaging experience.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes[/b]: We've squashed numerous bugs, big and small, to ensure a more stable and enjoyable game.
[*] [b]Continuous Engagement and Support[/b]: Your ongoing feedback has been our guiding light, shaping the future of EreaDrone 2023.
[/list]

[b]We are immensely grateful for your support, patience, and constructive criticism.[/b] It's because of you that EreaDrone 2023 is not just a simulator, but a growing, thriving community. Dive into the detailed changelog below to see how your suggestions have come to life. [b]Your feedback is invaluable to us[/b]; please consider sharing your thoughts and experiences with EreaDrone 2023 by [b]writing a review on Steam[/b] – it helps us immensely!

Here's to flying higher and racing faster – together!

Warm regards,

The EreaDrone 2023 Team

[hr][/hr] 

[h2]EreaDrone 2023 - Detailed changelog[/h2]

[b][color=#4CAF50]🆕 New Features & Enhancements[/color][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Physics Overhaul[/b]:
[list]
    [*]Direct Control Mode: Disable PID for quicker, more reactive drone control.
    [*]Refined Air Drag Parameters: Experience realistic low and medium-speed air resistance.
    [*]Expanded Physics Parameters: Enjoy a broader range of settings, including an expanded -100/100% air drag parameter.
    [*]Improved Air Drag Mechanics: Reduced "floaty" sensation for a more grounded flight experience.
[/list]
[*][b]In-Game Track Leaderboards[/b]: Track your rankings easily with in-game leaderboards.
[*][b]Map Editor Upgrades[/b]: Unleash your creativity with an array of new obstacles and elements.
[*][b]Dynamic Leaderboard Updates[/b]: Achieve a personal best lap time and see your new rank instantly.
[*][b]Customizable Pod Inclination[/b]: Set your pod's angle to your preference, starting at a default 5°.
[*][b]Enhanced Path Customization[/b]: Adjust the path's thickness, opacity, and distance to suit your style.
[*][b]Cloud-Independent Profile Saving[/b]: Your drone profiles are now securely stored in your EreaDrone account.
[*][b]Fisheye Camera Simulation[/b]: Experience realistic FPV with our new fisheye effect, replicating actual camera distortion.
[*][b]Additional Minor Features[/b]: Including enhancements like the new crosshair and more.
[/list]

[b][color=#FF9800]🚀 Optimizations[/color][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Smoother Gameplay[/b]: Eliminated stuttering and FPS drops for a seamless simulation experience.
[*][b]FPS Enhancement[/b]: Enjoy an overall increase in frames per second.
[*][b]Environment Optimization[/b]: Optimized natural elements like trees and bushes for better performance.
[*][b]General Performance Tweaks[/b]: Continuous improvements across all environmental aspects.
[/list]

[b][color=#F44336]🔧 Bug Fixes[/color][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Improved Stability[/b]: Significantly reduced crashes and enhanced overall game stability.
[*][b]First Gate Respawn Logic[/b]: Addressed the issue of unintentional gate triggers on respawning.
[*][b]Stable Progress Bar[/b]: Smooth, vibration-free progress tracking.
[*][b]Multiplayer Lobby Menu[/b]: Resolved the missing context menu issue.
[*][b]Correct Keyboard Prompts[/b]: Enhanced user interface with accurate keyboard prompts.
[*][b]Autofocus Correction[/b]: Reduced unintended blurring.
[*][b]Accurate Ranking System[/b]: Fixed discrepancies during and after races.
[*][b]Comprehensive Fixes[/b]: Numerous major and minor bugs addressed for an improved gaming experience.
[/list]

[b][color=#2196F3]🔜 Upcoming Features (Work in Progress)[/color][/b]

[list]
[*][b]eDrone System Integration[/b]: Get ready for events like the 2023 FAI eDrone Racing Cup, Namwon, Korea.
[*][b]More Drone Models[/b]: Expanding the fleet with a variety of new drone models.
[*][b]More Environments[/b]: Introducing more immersive and varied environments.
[*][b]More Map Editor Elements[/b]: Enhancing creativity with a wider range of map editor elements.
[*][b]Enhanced Map Editor[/b]: Soon introducing multi-select functionality for easier editing.
[*][b]Expansive Future Updates[/b]: Preparing to add numerous additional features to further enrich the EreaDrone experience.
[/list]

If you're enjoying EreaDrone 2023, we'd be grateful if you could take a moment to [b]write a review on Steam[/b]. Your support and feedback mean the world to us!

[b]Stay tuned for more updates as we continually enhance your EreaDrone 2023 experience![/b]
